open_session_id.description: The session still open on this topic, if any; the client resumes it instead of starting one.

last_session_at_ms.description: Start of the topic's latest session, backend clock, Unix epoch ms; absent when the topic has no session or it is unknown. Since protocol 1.1.

pending_count.description: Open pending-review items (doubts awaiting the student) of the topic; absent when unknown. Since protocol 1.1.
